issue.title: SUBPIX rejected-candidate fallback drops recoverable foreign IDs before ambiguity gate
issue.actual: 14px ID7 + ID0 in a 320x240 synthetic frame returns OBSERVED and (7,)
issue.expected: UNKNOWN / foreign_or_ambiguous_marker, with both recovered IDs retained
issue.downstream: _ground_component may derive grasp from OBSERVED marker when complete target geometry is missing; this review demonstrates decoder error, not a real robot failure.

original_failure.assertion: Expected ambiguity rejection for recoverable ID7 + ID0; current fallback discards ID0

root_cause: _decode_subpix_rejected_candidates compares samples only against registration.marker_id; detect_pose_marker replaces native no-IDs result with this target-filtered list. len(observed)==1 then loses the foreign/ambiguity evidence.
proposed_fix: Decode rejected candidates against all 50 registered-dictionary codewords with exact 6x6 border-inclusive equality and four rotations; return all recovered IDs and aligned ordered corners before existing single-marker/foreign gate. Remove target-only filter from production fallback. Preserve existing sampling, refinement, thresholds, no-error-correction policy, and native-success path.
